descriptions: You can download a trial version of this app to try it for 15 minutes for free.
You won’t be charged anything when this free trial ends. You can’t make in-app purchases or use add-on content during this free trial, but you’ll keep any achievements you earn.

display_long_description:
Strap in — it's 1918, and the golden age of aerial combat has invaded your living room!

**AR Dogfight: SPADs & Fokkers** turns your real space into a miniature Western Front.  Authentic WWI fighters at miniature scales bank and weave around your furniture in full mixed reality, ducking behind the sofa and screaming past the bookshelf.

These aren't arcade gliders.  A genuine aerodynamics model — lift, drag, stalls, and energy management — is tuned for small-scale play, so a SPAD S.XIII and a Fokker D.VII handle like the real machines shrunk to your tabletop.  Open the throttle and take off straight from the carpet, then grease a landing back onto your coffee table.

Between sorties, walk around your full-scale plane parked right in your room.

In the air, optionally point your laser designator to assist running down enemies with hairpin turns and thrilling dives.  This is no hit-point sponge — control surfaces snap off, wings break, and damaged engines trail fire before spiraling into the floor.   Plane scales are adjustable from 1/1 to 1/192, making even outdoor play exciting!

Battle a 50-mission Campaign against escalating waves or jump into quick Dogfight skirmishes.  Earn victories, climb the ranks, unlock medals and liveries, and share your score on the global leaderboards.

The skies are waiting. Chocks away!
